aliasPolicy: All stored mode aliases are checked for an existing target and matching resolved type. This is not proof of every node binding or alias cycle resolution.
scopePolicy: Picker scopes are checked against the SDK enum and library type conventions. Empty scope arrays are valid hidden variables. Scopes do not restrict Plugin API binding.
webPolicy: Aureform's source-token convention requires one portable var(--ascii-custom-property). This is a library convention, not the set of all valid Figma WEB syntax.
timingPolicy: Owner records actual read completion and raw return hashes externally so multipart reads stay deterministic.
